fact: 1934年12月1日，列宁格勒州委书记、政治局委员谢尔盖·基洛夫在斯莫尔尼宫办公室被列昂尼德·尼古拉耶夫从后颈开枪射杀；尼古拉耶夫及多名被指控同谋在公审后30天内处决。基洛夫遇刺被斯大林用作启动莫斯科审判与大清洗的理由。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Sergei Kirov
sources.quote: On 1 December 1934, Kirov was shot and killed by Leonid Nikolaev at his offices in the Smolny Institute. Nikolaev and several alleged accomplices were convicted in a show trial and executed less than 30 days later. Kirov assassination was used by Stalin as a reason for starting the Moscow trials and the Great Purge.

fact: 尼古拉耶夫1934年10月15日曾携带纳甘左轮手枪进入斯莫尔尼宫，被警觉警卫检查公文包后逮捕；数小时后公文包与上膛手枪被归还并被勒令离开大楼。他是被开除党籍的失业前基层干部，因生活困难与对开除他的党委有怨气而行刺。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Sergei Kirov
sources.quote: On 15 October 1934, Nikolayev packed his Nagant revolver in a briefcase and entered the Smolny Institute... he was arrested after an alert guard asked to examine his briefcase, which was found to contain the revolver. A few hours later, Nikolayev briefcase and loaded revolver were returned to him, and he was told to leave the building.

fact: 苏联1917年十月革命后废除帝国内部护照制度，劳动手册成为主要身份证明；1932年重新引入护照制度，公开目的是改善人口登记并从主要工业城市与敏感地区清除隐藏的富农与危险政治分子及不从事社会有益劳动者。1934年基洛夫遇刺后护照制度与登记（propiska）进一步强化。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Internal passport (Soviet Union section)
sources.quote: In 1932, the passport regime was reintroduced, its declared purpose to improve the registration of population and relieve major industrial cities and other sensitive localities of hiding kulaks and dangerous political elements and those not engaged in labor of social usefulness.

fact: 苏联内部护照通过propiska登记制度将人绑定在永久居住地；有效propiska是接受高等教育或医疗的前提，也是在某地址居住的权利。所有居民依法须在证件上登记地址并向内务部地方部门报告变更。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Internal passport (Soviet Union section)
sources.quote: passports were used to control and monitor the place of residence by means of the propiska, a regulation designed to control the population internal movement by binding a person to his or her permanent place of residence... a valid propiska was necessary to receive higher education or medical treatment.

fact: 1934年苏联处于计划经济第二个五年计划期间，货币由国家银行发行，外汇与贵金属由国家垄断；私人贸易基本被取消，工业企业由国家经营。基洛夫遇刺后政治风险上升，工厂经理与技术人员因间隙破坏罪被清洗的风险开始累积。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Sergei Kirov
sources.quote: Kirov assassination was used by Stalin as a reason for starting the Moscow trials and his campaign of terror known as the Great Purge.

fact: 1934年苏联城市居民凭票供应基本食品与工业品；内部护照与propiska将人绑定在居住地，无莫斯科或列宁格勒登记的外来者难以在城市合法居住、就学或就医。工厂经理与技术人员的空缺在清洗中由快速提拔的工人填补。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Internal passport (Soviet Union section)
sources.quote: a valid propiska was necessary to receive higher education or medical treatment, although these services were not limited to the location registered... having a propiska at a certain address meant that one had the right to live there.

fact: 1934年苏联第二个五年计划重点发展重工业与军备；但大清洗前奏中工厂经理与技术人员被以破坏罪清洗，导致工业管理岗位空缺、生产纪律松弛。古拉格经济作为强制劳动补充在1930年代扩张。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Sergei Kirov
sources.quote: Kirov assassination was used by Stalin as a reason for starting the Moscow trials and his campaign of terror known as the Great Purge.

fact: 基洛夫遇刺后尼古拉耶夫及多名被指控同谋在30天内被处决；清洗前奏中，前党干部、失业者、被开除党籍者成为重点监控对象。尼古拉耶夫本人是被开除党籍的失业前基层干部，因生活困难与怨气而行刺。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Sergei Kirov
sources.quote: Nikolaev and several alleged accomplices were convicted in a show trial and executed less than 30 days later... He was an expelled party member and a failed junior functionary, with a murderous grudge and an indifference to his own survival.
